Growth and profitability statements in S1–S6 flow directly from the described drivers and outcomes without internal contradictions. S7–S9 logically link the end of cost-minimization efforts to the new Vision 2030 strategy and specific initiatives. S12 appropriately qualifies the short-term margin impact of investments while projecting future benefits, maintaining coherence throughout. No repetition or organizational issues are present.
